title: ProvenJournalEntry
description: ADR-025 T3 evidence tier — one VALIDATED LIVE-RUN result. The highest-trust memory in the scoping loop (T3 > T2 > T1), so writes are USER-CONFIRMED ONLY: entries are added exclusively through `python -m src.scoping.journal add` with an interactive confirmation prompt. Agents read this journal; they can never write it — that write gate guards against self-reinforcing noise / memory poisoning.

mlflow_run_id.description: MLflow run id of the finalized model the live result validates — the lineage anchor.

start.description: ISO date the live evaluation window started.

end.description: ISO date the live evaluation window ended.

realized_metrics.description: Realized out-of-sample/live metrics, e.g. {precision_at_tau: 0.86, n_signals: 41, pnl_points: 310}.

success_rationale.description: WHY this model is a proven success — the criteria met and why the result is expected to generalize. Load-bearing for scoping Pass B: it lets a later scoping run reuse the proven result as authoritative evidence without re-deriving it, and flags when the success may NOT transfer (e.g. it was proven under different objective requirements).

_match.description: Set by load_proven_evidence at read time ('exact' | 'base'); never written to the journal.

user_confirmed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the interactive confirmation. Set by the journal CLI at the moment the operator answers 'y' — its presence is the write-gate receipt.
